paper_title: Dynamic alterations in the lung microbiota in a rat model of lipopolysaccharide-induced acute lung injury
primary_disease: acute lung injury / acute respiratory distress syndrome (ALI/ARDS)

relationships.primary_disease: acute lung injury / acute respiratory distress syndrome (ALI/ARDS)

_annotation_metadata.review_notes: Brevibacterium significantly increased in LPS12 (early ALI) vs Control. Additionally found to have strong positive correlation with inflammatory markers TNF-alpha, IL-6, IL-10, and NEU%. Confirmed by LEfSe analysis.
_annotation_metadata.verbatim_evidence: At the genus level, Brevibacterium, Motilimonas, Enterococcus, Faecalibacterium, and Ligilactobacillus were significantly increased in the LPS12 group versus the Control group, whereas Lactiplantibacillus and Paracoccus were significantly decreased.
_annotation_metadata.direction_reasoning: The quote explicitly states Brevibacterium was significantly increased in the LPS12 group versus the Control group, confirming increased direction in early ALI vs healthy control.
